## RESERVED_APP_ROUTE_SEGMENTS variable

Names that can never be an app's route segment.

**Signature:**

```typescript
RESERVED_APP_ROUTE_SEGMENTS: readonly string[]
```

## Remarks

Each names a namespace or route that a macts host serves, or will serve, beside the apps, so an app spelled the same way would collide with it on some surface:

- `rpc`<!-- -->: the operation routes, `/api/v1/rpc/<operation id>` over HTTP; - `introspect`<!-- -->: the operation listings, `/api/v1/introspect` over HTTP, which predate the namespace rule and stay under `/api/v1` for compatibility; - `references`<!-- -->: reference resolution (`/references/v1` over HTTP), which resolves references of every app; - `transfers`<!-- -->: binary transfers, which will move file bytes for every app at `/transfers/v1` over HTTP. Nothing is served there yet; the name is reserved so that no app can claim it first.

The runtime refuses an app with any of these route segments at registration (`registerManifest` and `registerContract`<!-- -->), so no host, HTTP or otherwise, can serve one. A segment is compared after normalization (`normalizeAppRouteSegment` in `@macts/core`<!-- -->), the spelling every surface uses.
